summary: **Turn any Git repository into a guided, interactive course.** Point it at a repo, and Curriculo reads the code, orders the concepts, and produces a learning path: sequenced lessons tied to real files, quizzes drawn from the actual code, and a `LEARN.md` you can commit. Execution starts in `engine/index.js`, `cli/index.js`. This course walks through 4 lessons, from entry points to the most-imported modules.

lessons.title: Where execution starts
lessons.body:
Find the entry points and see what they wire together.

**`engine/index.js`** — 106 lines (declared entry point, imported by ~2 files, core directory). Curriculo engine: a UI-less library shared by the CLI and the Claude skill. ingest -> rank -> synthesize (BharatCode or offline heuristics) -> manifest -> LEARN.md
Key definitions: `DEFAULTS` (engine/index.js:23), `writeOutputs` (engine/index.js:26), `generateCourse` (engine/index.js:39).

**`cli/index.js`** — 214 lines (declared entry point).
Key definitions: `paint` (cli/index.js:22), `fail` (cli/index.js:59), `int` (cli/index.js:64), `findCourseRoot` (cli/index.js:71), `cmdGen` (cli/index.js:81), `cmdLearn` (cli/index.js:127).

Suggested reading order: `engine/index.js` → `cli/index.js`.

quiz.q: Which of these files is imported by the most other files in the repo?
quiz.why: `engine/index.js` is imported by about 2 other file(s), making it the most load-bearing of the set.

lessons.title: `engine/`: `util.js`, `slice.js`, `manifest.js`, `ingest.js`
lessons.body:
Understand what engine/ is responsible for.

**`engine/util.js`** — 120 lines (imported by ~9 files, core directory).
Key definitions: `sha` (engine/util.js:6), `estTokens` (engine/util.js:11), `pool` (engine/util.js:16), `readJSON` (engine/util.js:30), `writeJSON` (engine/util.js:38), `toPosix` (engine/util.js:43).

**`engine/slice.js`** — 156 lines (imported by ~3 files, core directory). Signal-region slicing: cut a file down to the parts that teach the most (top of file, declarations, exports) so prompts stay within budget.
Key definitions: `extractSymbols` (engine/slice.js:43), `commentAt` (engine/slice.js:68), `leadingDoc` (engine/slice.js:103), `signalSlice` (engine/slice.js:129).

**`engine/manifest.js`** — 117 lines (imported by ~3 files, core directory).
Key definitions: `MANIFEST_VERSION` (engine/manifest.js:4), `STATE_DIR` (engine/manifest.js:5), `manifestPath` (engine/manifest.js:7), `progressPath` (engine/manifest.js:11), `quizError` (engine/manifest.js:19), `normalizeQuiz` (engine/manifest.js:30).

**`engine/ingest.js`** — 247 lines (imported by ~2 files, core directory).
Key definitions: `IGNORE_DIRS` (engine/ingest.js:8), `MAX_FILE_BYTES` (engine/ingest.js:45), `MAX_FILES` (engine/ingest.js:46), `isSecretPath` (engine/ingest.js:48), `shouldSkip` (engine/ingest.js:53), `isRemote` (engine/ingest.js:66).

Suggested reading order: `util.js` → `slice.js` → `manifest.js` → `ingest.js`.

quiz.why: `engine/util.js` is imported by about 9 other file(s), making it the most load-bearing of the set.

lessons.title: `engine/`: `offline.js`, `llm.js`, `synth.js`, `prompts.js`
lessons.body:
Understand what engine/ is responsible for.

**`engine/offline.js`** — 196 lines (imported by ~2 files, core directory). Heuristic course generation with no model calls. Used by `--offline`, as the outline fallback when the model's outline is unusable, and as the degraded body for a lesson whose synthesis failed.
Key definitions: `readmeBlurb` (engine/offline.js:17), `groupKey` (engine/offline.js:34), `chunk` (engine/offline.js:41), `offlineOutline` (engine/offline.js:50), `languageMix` (engine/offline.js:99), `offlineLessonBody` (engine/offline.js:107).

**`engine/llm.js`** — 141 lines (imported by ~2 files, core directory).
Key definitions: `BudgetError` (engine/llm.js:5), `configFromEnv` (engine/llm.js:16), `missingConfig` (engine/llm.js:24), `sleep` (engine/llm.js:32), `BharatCodeClient` (engine/llm.js:38), `extractText` (engine/llm.js:126).

**`engine/synth.js`** — 136 lines (imported by ~1 file, core directory). Model-backed course synthesis: outline -> lessons (parallel) -> quizzes. Every response is validated; a bad response is retried once, then the lesson degrades to a file list without a quiz instead of failing the run.
Key definitions: `callValidated` (engine/synth.js:15), `validateOutline` (engine/synth.js:27), `cleanBody` (engine/synth.js:46), `validateBody` (engine/synth.js:56), `validateQuiz` (engine/synth.js:65), `synthesizeWithModel` (engine/synth.js:74).

**`engine/prompts.js`** — 87 lines (imported by ~1 file, core directory). The three-step prompt chain: repo summary + outline, lesson synthesis, quiz generation. Every prompt sees only a ranked, budgeted slice of the repo.
Key definitions: `outlinePrompt` (engine/prompts.js:11), `lessonPrompt` (engine/prompts.js:41), `quizPrompt` (engine/prompts.js:65), `retrySuffix` (engine/prompts.js:84).

Suggested reading order: `offline.js` → `llm.js` → `synth.js` → `prompts.js`.

quiz.why: `engine/offline.js` is imported by about 2 other file(s), making it the most load-bearing of the set.

lessons.title: Inside `cli/`
lessons.body:
Understand what cli/ is responsible for.

**`cli/tui.js`** — 355 lines (imported by ~1 file). Dependency-free terminal UI: lesson list -> lesson view -> quiz, with progress persisted to .curriculo/progress.json so a course can be resumed.
Key definitions: `stripAnsi` (cli/tui.js:22), `wrap` (cli/tui.js:25), `styleLine` (cli/tui.js:47), `loadProgress` (cli/tui.js:59), `editorCommand` (cli/tui.js:65), `runTUI` (cli/tui.js:75).
